body.statement: Fix \(\mathcal A\) and condition on \(\operatorname{TID\text{-}SCG}(H,L,\mathcal A,X,Y,\gamma,x,y)=\operatorname{SUCCESS}(F)\). For one stationary trajectory in \(\Omega_{\mathcal A}\), geometric beta mixing and boundedness of the indicators of the finitely many returned cylinders \(C_{\mathcal A,j}\) imply the moment and mixing hypotheses used for Newey--West HAC consistency. With modified Bartlett weights \(1-k/(h_T+1)\), \(h_T\to\infty\), and \(h_T=o(T^{1/4})\), \(\widehat\Omega_F\overset p\to\Omega_F\), \(\sqrt T(\widehat\theta_F-\theta_M(y;x))\Rightarrow N(0,v_F)\), \(\widehat v_F\overset p\to v_F\), and \(P_M\{\theta_M(y;x)\in[\widehat\theta_F\pm z_{1-\alpha/2}\sqrt{\widehat v_F/T}]\}\to1-\alpha\). The limit is invariant under algebraically equivalent expressions in \(\mathcal L_{\mathrm{cyl}}(\mathcal A)\) after redundant simplex coordinates are removed.
body.justification: Every sound successful cylinder functional receives a proved single-trajectory limit law and interval.
body.gap: Inference is conditional on identification and cannot resolve an unknown query.
body.consumer: Certified EasyRCA scores obtain HAC uncertainty quantification.
body.proof_tex:
On the event \(\operatorname{TID\text{-}SCG}=\operatorname{SUCCESS}(F)\), success soundness in \(\mathrm{thm:tid\text{-}dichotomy}\) gives the load-bearing identifying equality
\[
 F(p_F)=\theta_M(y;x)
\]
for every \(M\in\mathfrak M(H,L,\mathcal A)\).  All remaining hypotheses of \(\mathrm{lem:valid\text{-}cylinder\text{-}hac\text{-}delta}\) are exactly \(\mathrm{ass:strict\text{-}stationarity}\), \(\mathrm{ass:cylinder\text{-}positivity}\), \(\mathrm{ass:geometric\text{-}beta\text{-}mixing}\), \(\mathrm{ass:hac\text{-}kernel}\), \(\mathrm{ass:hac\text{-}bandwidth}\), and \(\mathrm{ass:variance\text{-}nondegeneracy}\).  Applying that lemma yields HAC consistency, the centered delta-method limit, consistency of \(\widehat v_F\), Wald coverage, and representation invariance exactly as stated.  The arbitrary off-domain definition in that lemma is immaterial because the empirical denominators are positive with probability tending to one.
